summary: Load-bearing term audit (docs/notes/load-bearing-terms.md): 128 disambiguations reach the root; none had a case-splitting result, coverage or exclusivity statement. Certified sense forks for 'prior' (PrioritySense: simply, inTime, inSubstance) and 'cause' (CauseSense: moving, efficient, perfection, origin) in TruthCore.Causality.TermSenseForks: joint theorems by cases PRIOR-SENSE-FORK-ACT-SIMPLY-PRIOR and CAUSE-SENSE-FORK-NO-SELF-EFFICIENT-CAUSE, per-branch results, two conditional refutations (temporal priority; no self-caused perfection), one strengthens relation (Aristotle's no-self-mover over the same-respect reading), uses-agree results from exclusivity, and controls (omission model for every joint premise, nonvacuity per fork, coverage-without-exclusivity models). Rejected leads: (1) a bridge from priority in time to simple priority, because ST I q.3 a.1 grants potency prior in time within one changing thing while act is simply prior; (2) closing the perfection branch of 'cause' by a bridge from efficient causing to causing a perfection, since the perfection reading is refuted under the self-perfecting-subject premise; (3) refuting the moving branch with an 'something moves itself' premise, rejected because it contradicts the existing Aristotle reading STMT-NO-MOVER-MOVES-ITSELF-IN-ITS-RESPECT, which the branch reuses instead; (4) a new disambiguation of 'authority', deferred because it needs a dedicated claimed-divine-authority definition and lane B route links; (5) an 'eternal' fork, deferred because Eternal is a primitive with no temporal model, so a fork could not fail. Semantic linkage audit 2026-11-09: corrected PRIOR_1 and PRIOR_3 sense/definition declarations from quantified statement readings to the existing independent PriorityFrame relation projections; corrected the stale temporal-predicate absence claim. Inspected exact field and statement types, existing fork context, related search and dossiers. Detailed primitive meanings, recursive boundaries, rejected duplicate bridge proofs and remaining type-level grounding gap are preserved in docs/notes/load-bearing-terms.md. This is metadata correction, not a new proof or premise discharge. Follow-up #1233 audit (2026-11-09): corrected CAUSE_1/2/4 sense locators to CauseFrame.MovesIn/CausesIn/CausesOrigin and the latter two definition locators to those primitive fields. Found that stable CAUSE_3 is the four-mode classification, not the third CauseSense constructor. Rejected renumbering or replacing CAUSE_3 with efficient causing: that would change its identity and conceal the fork/list mismatch. No Lean, statement, argument or Challenge changed; no premise change. Full findings and examples are in docs/notes/load-bearing-terms.md. CAUSE_3 declaration completion (2026-11-09): FourCauseModes packages the exact Physics.FourCauseExhaustiveReading over explicit separate carriers and five binary primitive relations. Bound the existing sense UUID and definition without renumbering, altering route coverage or adding a source claim. Rejected object tags, disjoint-mode strengthening, implicit converse and equating source-of-change with the route efficient relation. Local controls test failed coverage, overlapping roles and lack of converse. Primitive applicability and root bridge remain open; details persist in DEF-ARISTOTELIAN-CAUSE-MODES. No premise change.
blocker: Coverage and exclusivity of both terms are OPEN frontier premises; coverage of 'cause' excludes grounding (Ontic.Causes) and Aristotle's formal, material and final causes, which are the named attacks. The bridges STMT-PRIOR-IN-SUBSTANCE-IS-SIMPLE, STMT-SELF-EFFICIENT-CAUSATION-IS-SELF-MOVING and STMT-SELF-EFFICIENT-CAUSATION-IS-SELF-ORIGINATION and the refuting premises STMT-TEMPORALLY-FIRST-BEING-IN-POTENCY and STMT-SOME-SUBJECT-CAUSES-ITS-OWN-PERFECTION remain open.
